note: National Park Service campground in the Ozark National Scenic Riverways, in woods above the Current River off Highway 19. 46 sites take an RV; only the six E sites have hookups (50-amp electric and water), the rest are basic. Posted lengths run from 20 ft (sites 12-14) to 60 ft. Eight more sites are tent-only, six of them walk-in along the spring branch. Reservation only, same-day included. In winter (Oct 16 to Apr 14) the water is off except the heated shower house. No cell signal. --Claude
summary: Confirmed against rec.gov and the NPS API: year-round, reservation-only since 2025-01-01, 46 RV sites of which six (E1-E6) have 50A + water, no sewer, dump at the entrance; $20/$30 in season, $10/$20 Oct 16-Apr 14. Site count corrected 62 -> 54 family sites (the 62 included 8 group sites). Not waterfront stands. Pin is ~380 m north of the campground - move flagged. No stored phone - two published numbers flagged.
